--                                VINQ HUB | HITBOX EXPANDER (TEST)                                --
--                                  DEVELOPMENT & TESTING ARCHITECTURE                            --
--=================================================================================================--

if not game:IsLoaded() then 
    game.Loaded:Wait() 
end

local _plrs_string = string.char(80,108,97,121,101,114,115)
local _plrs = game:GetService(_plrs_string)
local _lp = _plrs.LocalPlayer

-- UI Library Loading Layer
local _v_hook = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/dawid-scripts/Fluent/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()

    TextColor = _vinq_text_color,
    MainColor = _vinq_main_grey,
    AccentColor = _vinq_acc_grey,
    BackgroundColor = _vinq_back_dark,
    OutlineColor = _vinq_line_grey
}

-- Root Menu Architecture Execution Window
local _v_window = _v_hook:CreateWindow({
    Title = "VINQ HUB | Hitbox Expander (Test)",
    SubTitle = "Slap Battles Edition",
    TabWidth = 160,
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(580, 540), 
    Acrylic = false,
    Theme = "Dark",
    MinimizeKey = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl
})

-- Dynamic Parameters (Runtime Configuration Memory Pointers)
local _cfg_enabled = false
local _cfg_width   = 10  
local _cfg_height  = 10   
local _cfg_depth   = 10   
local _cfg_trans   = 0.4 -- Lowered default for high visibility profile
local _cfg_team    = false

-- Allocation Framework Tables for Navigation Elements
local _v_tabs = {
    Hitbox = _v_window:AddTab({ Title = "Hitbox Expander", Icon = "target" }),
    BugsAndFixes = _v_window:AddTab({ Title = "Bugs And Fixes", Icon = "wrench" })
}

-- Auto-Focus Initial Workspace Profile
_v_window:SelectTab(_v_tabs.Hitbox)

--=================================================================================================--
-- TAB 1: HITBOX EXPANDER WORKING WORKSPACE
--=================================================================================================--

_v_tabs.Hitbox:AddParagraph({
    Title = "VINQ HITBOX TEST",
    Content = "Adjust length and scale parameters below. This is an official test profile."
})

local Tgl_1 = _v_tabs.Hitbox:AddToggle("HitboxToggle", { 
    Title = "Enable Hitbox Expander", 
    Default = false 
})

-- Master Linking Slider

})

local Sld_D = _v_tabs.Hitbox:AddSlider("DepthSlider", {
    Title = "Hitbox Depth (Front/Back)",
    Description = "Adjusts standard forward depth profiling",
    Default = 10, Min = 2, Max = 50, Rounding = 1
})

local Sld_T = _v_tabs.Hitbox:AddSlider("TransSlider", {
    Title = "Hitbox Transparency",
    Description = "Grey box field opacity parameters (Lower = More Visible)",
    Default = 0.4, Min = 0, Max = 1, Rounding = 1
})

local Tgl_2 = _v_tabs.Hitbox:AddToggle("TeamToggle", { 
    Title = "Team Check", 
    Default = false 
})

--=================================================================================================--
-- TAB 2: BUGS AND FIXES INFORMATIONAL LOGS
--=================================================================================================--

_v_tabs.BugsAndFixes:AddParagraph({
    Title = "Beta Notice / Log Profiles",
    Content = "This is in beta. Don't think just because it's out doesn't mean it won't bug out. More updates soon! Maybe?"
})

--=================================================================================================--
-- RUNTIME CALLBACK MONITOR PIPELINES
--=================================================================================================--

Tgl_1:OnChanged(function(_val) 
    _cfg_enabled = _val 
    _v_hook:Notify({
        Title = "VINQ HUB STATUS",
        Content = _cfg_enabled and "Hitbox: on" or "Hitbox: off",
        Duration = 2
    })
end)

-- Intercept Master Slider to push value to sub-sliders
Sld_All:OnChanged(function(_val)
    _cfg_width = _val
    _cfg_height = _val
    _cfg_depth = _val
    Sld_W:SetValue(_val)
    Sld_H:SetValue(_val)
    Sld_D:SetValue(_val)
end)

Sld_W:OnChanged(function(_val) _cfg_width = _val end)
Sld_H:OnChanged(function(_val) _cfg_height = _val end)
Sld_D:OnChanged(function(_val) _cfg_depth = _val end)
Sld_T:OnChanged(function(_val) _cfg_trans = _val end)
Tgl_2:OnChanged(function(_val) _cfg_team = _val end)

--=================================================================================================--
-- ASYNCHRONOUS ENGINE LOOP TRACKER
--=================================================================================================--

task.spawn(function()
    while true do 
        task.wait(0.1) 
        
        if _cfg_enabled and _lp then
            for _, p in ipairs(_plrs:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= _lp then
                    if not _cfg_team or (_cfg_team and p.Team ~= _lp.Team) then
                        pcall(function()
                            local character = p.Character
                            local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            
                            if root then
                                -- Custom structural highly visible grey configurations applied here
                                root.Size = Vector3.new(_cfg_width, _cfg_height, _cfg_depth)
                                root.Transparency = _cfg_trans
                                root.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
                                root.Material = Enum.Material.Neon -- Neon material makes it highly visible in combat arenas
                                root.CanCollide = false
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            -- Automatic safe cleanup/reset sequence when toggled completely off
            for _, p in ipairs(_plrs:GetPlayers()) do
                pcall(function()
                    local character = p.Character
                    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    
                    if root then
                        root.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
                        root.Transparency = 1
                        root.CanCollide = true
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end)

--=================================================================================================--

_v_hook:Notify({

    Duration = 10
})

scripts.script:
local MULTIPLIER = 30

local function makeBigger(part)
    if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end

    part.Size = part.Size * MULTIPLIER
    part.CanTouch = true
    part.CanQuery = true
    part.CanCollide = true

    -- important for consistent touch detection
    part.Massless = true
end

local function isProjectile(obj)
    return obj.Name == "Projectile"
        or obj.Name == "Fireball"
        or obj.Name == "Iceball"
        or obj.Name == "Table"
        or obj.Name == "RAIGTable"
        or obj.Name == "Pellet"
        or obj.Name == "Soccerball"
        or obj.Name == "BigRocket"
        or obj.Name == "Rocket"
        or obj.Name == "Basketball"
        or obj.Name == "Molotov"
        or obj.Name == "Grenade"
        or obj.Name == "Cesusbomb"
        or obj.Name == "Cesuspot"
        or obj.Name == "LilCesuspot"
        or obj.Name == "Banana"
        or obj.Name == "Pie"
        or obj.Name == "Brew"
        or obj.Name == "Goala"
        or obj.Name == "Cola"
        or obj.Name == "FireTeapot"
        or obj.Name == "Teapot"
end

local function applyToObject(obj)
    if isProjectile(obj) then
        if obj:IsA("Model") then
            for _, d in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                makeBigger(d)
            end
        else
            makeBigger(obj)
        end
    end
end

-- handle existing objects
for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    applyToObject(obj)
end

-- handle new ones
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
    task.wait() -- ensures properties are ready
    applyToObject(obj)
end)
